title: 第一卷第21章 一场意外的车祸第一卷第22章 月瑶病重
content_zh:
;;
“说，是谁指使你们的？”
君无邪眼神冷酷地俯视中年人。
“杀人越货，需要谁指使？”
中年人说道。
“让我来猜猜。”君无邪脸上带着一抹冷笑：“你身上有血煞之气，但基本不属于人类，应该是杀了许多凶兽累积下来的。”
中年人面无表情。
“你们是某个佣兵团的赏金猎人，来自青阳城之外的城池。我得到大河海选令和聚气丹之事，目前只有青阳城的人知道，所以你们跟青阳城的某人有关。”
中年人眼角跳了一下，脸色变了。
这个少年，居然在如此短的时间内，分析得这么清晰！
“呵，你们所在的城池，应该比青阳城大，才会有你这种凝气境的人物。青阳城除了猎人公会，还有谁能请得动你们？”
“你……”中年人态度转变，沉声道：“我若说了，你是否答应不杀我？”
“说吧，我不杀你。”
君无邪点头。
“是袁季，青阳城猎人公会的管事，他许诺给我们铁骑佣兵团一个猎人公会成员的名额！”
袁季？
君无邪大致猜测是那个在猎人公会针对他的中年管事，结果还真是他。
“我都说了，你答应过不杀我！”
中年人希冀地看着君无邪。
君无邪却突然出手，一脚震碎了其丹田。

中年人惨叫，面孔扭曲，怒吼道：“你言而无信，该死的！”
咔嚓！
他话音刚落，双臂、双腿全被踩断了，中年人发出凄厉的惨叫。
“我向来一言九鼎，绝不会用我的身体杀你。”
君无邪收了其灵弓，驾着马车一冲而过，在中年人惊叫之中，碾压了过去，其血肉模糊，整个身子都被碾碎了。
“你是被车碾死的。”
君无邪淡淡开口，黄昏下，马车消失在官道的尽头。
他心里有些遗憾，那个袁季没有亲自来。
虽然袁季只是青阳城猎人公会的管事，但是由于猎人公会的特殊性，以其职位，能请出的高手还真不会少，甚至有可能发布隐藏任务悬赏他。
“无邪哥哥～”
车门打开，帘子掀起，小月瑶探出头来。
“月瑶，是不是刚才把你吵醒了？”

"Tell me, who ordered you?"
Jun Wuxie looked down at the middle-aged man with cold eyes.
"Who needs to instruct someone to kill and steal goods?"
The middle-aged man said.
"Let me guess." Jun Wuxie said with a sneer on his face: "You have blood evil aura, but it is basically not human. It should be accumulated from killing many ferocious beasts."
The middle-aged man's face was expressionless.
"You are bounty hunters from a certain mercenary group, coming from a city outside Qingyang City. The fact that I obtained the Great River Sea Selection Order and the Qi Gathering Pill is currently only known to people in Qingyang City, so you are related to someone in Qingyang City."
The middle-aged man's eyes twitched and his expression changed.
This young man could analyze so clearly in such a short period of time!
"Oh, the city you are in should be bigger than Qingyang City to have a Qi Condensing Realm character like you. Who else in Qingyang City besides the Hunter Guild can invite you?"
"You..." The middle-aged man's attitude changed and he said in a deep voice: "If I tell you, will you promise not to kill me?"
"Say it, I won't kill you."
Jun Wuxie nodded.
"It's Yuan Ji, the manager of the Hunter's Guild in Qingyang City. He promised to give our cavalry mercenary group a quota as a member of the Hunter's Guild!"
Yuan Ji?
Jun Wuxie roughly guessed that it was the middle-aged manager who targeted him at the Hunter Guild, and it turned out to be him.
"I told you, you promised not to kill me!"
The middle-aged man looked at Jun Wuxie expectantly.
Jun Wuxie suddenly took action and shattered his Dantian with a kick.
The middle-aged man screamed, his face twisted, and he roared: "You should be damned if you don't keep your word!"
Click!
As soon as he finished speaking, his arms and legs were trampled off, and the middle-aged man let out a shrill scream.
"I have always kept my promise and will never use my body to kill you."
Jun Wuxie put away his spiritual bow and rushed past with his carriage. As the middle-aged man screamed, he crushed him. His flesh and blood were blurred and his whole body was crushed.
"You were run over by a car."
Jun Wuxie spoke calmly, and at dusk, the carriage disappeared at the end of the official road.
He felt a little regretful that Yuan Ji didn't come in person.
Although Yuan Ji is only the manager of the Qingyang City Hunter Guild, due to the special nature of the Hunter Guild and his position, there are really not many experts that he can hire. It is even possible to issue hidden tasks to reward him.
"Brother Wuxie~"
The car door opened, the curtain lifted, and Xiao Yueyao poked her head out.
"Yue Yao, did I wake you up just now?"
